study: B5c matched cosine counterparts of the B1 step-decay arm
question: In the fresh test the discontinuous schedule families also used different architectures. Holding dataset, architecture, optimiser, learning rate, weight decay, batch size and horizon fixed, do the cosine counterparts of the four B1 step-decay jobs carry lower risk at the same frozen threshold?
fourth_pair: fashion_mnist: dev:fashion_mnist_resnet18 (cosine, same loader and seed) against b1:fashion_mnist_resnet18_step; included as a fourth matched pair drawn from the development corpus, labelled as such

evaluation.gate: declared-drop gate of the paper; inert on cosine by construction

predictions_fixed_before_the_run.P1: cosine counterparts realise lower risk than their step-decay partners at the same threshold
predictions_fixed_before_the_run.P2: the gate is inert on all of them, since cosine declares no drop
predictions_fixed_before_the_run.falsification: if the cosine counterparts violate at a rate comparable to their step partners, the fresh-test split is an architecture effect and the stratification claim fails
